name: com.aitrainingpay/ai-training-jobs
title: AI Training Pay
description: Live AI training jobs (RLHF, evaluation, annotation) with stated pay, plus platform legit checks.

tools.name: search_ai_training_jobs
tools.description: Search open AI training, RLHF, evaluation, annotation and expert-data roles across platforms' public job boards, best-paid first. Returns title, platform, field, places, stated pay and a link to each role.

query.description: Words that must appear in the role title, e.g. 'nurse', 'python', 'spanish'.

field.description: A field id or label, e.g. 'medicine', 'law', 'coding', 'languages'. Use list_platforms_and_fields for ids.

language.description: A language the role works in, e.g. 'Spanish'.

country.description: A country the role must be open to (roles open worldwide count too).

min_hourly.description: Minimum hourly pay in USD (top of the listed range).

tools.name: ai_training_pay
tools.description: Median listed hourly pay and open-role counts for AI training work, overall or by field, platform or language. 'Up to' ceilings are reported separately, never mixed into medians.

tools.name: ai_training_platform
tools.description: Sourced profile of an AI training platform (Mercor, Outlier, DataAnnotation, Handshake AI, micro1, xAI...): verdict on whether it's legit, who runs it, how and when it pays, how hiring works, with source links.

tools.name: new_ai_training_jobs
tools.description: Roles first posted in the last 7 days, best-paid first, optionally for one field or language.

tools.name: list_platforms_and_fields
tools.description: Every platform profiled (with its legit verdict) and every field id the other tools accept.
